photos.c: GARY STAINES hands to Stu Paton in the 25x1 mile relay.
Front Cover; Gary Staines takes off in the last lap of the AAA's Indoor 3000m to win from Billy Dee of Luton.
Kevin Sturman's determination shows as he and Gary Staines sprint for the line in the last Surrey C.C. League at Coulsdon.

Our victorious team after their outstanding win in the Wellington Relays held on the race course at Ostend.
Back row left to right; Mike Alleyne, Derrick Williams, Guy Sagar, Pat Lyttle, Dave Mote, Gary Staines, John Gladwin, Kevin Sturman, Richard Addison, and Mark Sinclair.
Front row left to right; Paul Richley, Stuart Paton, Oliver Foote, and Team Manager - Leo Coy.
Mark Sinclair follows Gary Staines in the last British League Match at Battersea Park and in so doing ran a p.b. for the 1500m.

Gary Staines seen here winning the Southern Counties 1500m title became our first sub-4 minute miler and ended a race packed season when in September he joined John Gladwin on an under 23 tour of mainland China. Gary also ranked 12th in the world with his 5.02.57 2000m.
Gary Staines finishing the final stage of the 25 x 1 mile Relay.

Gary Staines, fresh from his Olympic 5000m final spearheaded a fine Belgrave team effort in the first Surrey C.C.League Match. Gary (21), Jean Paul Wright (8), followed by Mark Sinclair, Matthew Stickles, Mike Hayes (20), Francis Ward, Marcello Bizio (15) and Ollie Foote (11).
FRONT COVER: In 1990 Gary Staines had his best ever season achieving a Silver in the European Championships and also running a 13:14.28 5000m to put him 4th on the U.K. all time list.

The senior team poses at Petersham prior to setting out on the first of the 1991/92 Surrey League cross country races. Back row (left to right): Colin Pearson, Gerry Adams, Chris Taplin, Paul Roche, Tony Stone, Mike Hayes, John Booth, Owen Lewis, Trevor Williams, Gary Staines, Roger Alsop, John Bicourt, Colin Bond, Jon Coy, John Mather, Marcello Bizio, Chris Millbank and Pete Gardner. Front row: Mike Nouch, Charles Dickinson, Stuart Paton, Don Anderson, M.Mazzotta, Mike Webb, Matt Kinane, John Wasbrough.

Above: Reebok Surrey XC League at Petersham. Left to right: Gary Staines had an "easy one" after resting from Tokyo. He started slowly, then worked through the field, encouraging the Bels. as he went.
Gary Staines had the measure of Kirk (Wolverhampton & Bilston) and Mangleshot (Woodford Green) in a tight finish to the 1,500m in the final BAL match
Left: A bronzed Gary Staines brought a little sunshine back for the final Surrey League Race at Coulsdon.

Front page photo: Gary Staines wanted to find out if he was a "Marathon Runner". After his 9th place in the London Marathon in 2:12:54 when he was second Briton home, the general consensus of opinion was "Yes, he is!". Our picture shows him on his way to a 63:31 win in the Reading Half-Marathon on March 31st.
Above: Gary Staines sets out on his second blistering run, having taken over from Steve Beaver.
